meta.title: Compress PDF - Reduce PDF File Size Online Free
meta.description: Compress PDF files online free and reduce PDF size with adjustable quality levels. No upload, no signup, no watermark — everything runs in your browser.

tagline: Compress PDF files and cut their size without uploading anything
pageDescription: Reduce PDF file size with this free, browser-based Compress PDF tool. Pick Lossless to shrink the file without losing quality and keep text selectable, or Light, Balanced and Strong to re-render pages as optimised images for much smaller files. Built for anyone hitting a 10 MB email or upload size limit. Your document is processed locally and never leaves your device, so confidential files stay secure. No signup, no watermarks.

instructions.title: How to compress a PDF

steps.title: Upload your PDF
steps.description: Drag and drop a PDF onto the upload area or click to browse. The file name, page count and current size appear right away.

steps.title: Choose a compression level
steps.description: Lossless rewrites the file structure and keeps text selectable. Light, Balanced and Strong re-render each page as a JPEG at 150, 120 or 96 DPI for far bigger savings.

steps.title: Fine-tune in Advanced settings (optional)
steps.description: Set an exact DPI between 36 and 300, move the JPEG quality slider, or switch pages to grayscale — ideal for scanned black-and-white documents.

steps.title: Compress the file
steps.description: Click Compress PDF. Pages are processed one by one in your browser and a live counter shows the progress.

steps.title: Check the savings and download
steps.description: Compare the original and compressed sizes with the percentage saved, then download the result as yourfile-compressed.pdf.

features: Four compression levels: Lossless plus Light, Balanced and Strong
Lossless mode keeps text vector-based and selectable
Custom DPI (36–300) and JPEG quality slider
Grayscale conversion for extra savings on scans
Before/after size comparison with exact percentage saved
Page size in points preserved, so the PDF still prints at the same format
Never returns a file bigger than the original
100% client-side — your PDF is never uploaded, no signup or watermark
useCases: Shrink a PDF below an email attachment limit
Compress a scanned contract before uploading it to a portal
Reduce a photo-heavy brochure so it loads fast on the web
Fit a portfolio PDF into a job application upload cap
Make a large invoice archive lighter for long-term storage
Compress a slide deck exported as PDF before sharing it
Cut the size of a scanned ID or certificate for a government form
Lower the weight of a manual before attaching it to a ticket
proTips: Try Lossless first when the text must stay searchable and selectable
Scans and photo-heavy PDFs shrink the most in Balanced or Strong
Grayscale often halves the size of a black-and-white scan
For print, stay at 150 DPI or above; 96 DPI is fine for screen reading
Target 10 MB or less when a mail client or portal rejects bigger attachments
If the savings look small, the PDF was likely already optimised
Need fewer pages instead of a smaller file? Use the Split PDF tool
troubleshooting: 0% saved: the file is already optimised — try Strong or enable grayscale
Text is no longer selectable: that is expected outside Lossless mode; switch back to Lossless
Pages look soft: raise the DPI or the JPEG quality in Advanced settings
Compression is slow: large or high-page-count PDFs take longer — pages are processed one by one
The PDF will not load: password-protected or corrupted files cannot be compressed
